Authentication Method: Manual Key
IPsec Primary Gateway Name or Address: Remote_FW_X1

49.steps:
1) On NAT_Device_FW, create a NAT policy and translate Local_FW_X1 into Translated_Local_X1; Add a WAN->LAN access rule to allow traffic from WAN to Translated_Local_X1
   2) Create TI (Tunnel Interface) VPN policy named 'test' on Local_FW as following:
Authentication Method: Preshared Secret
IPsec Primary Gateway Name or Address: Remote_FW_X1
On Proposals tab, select IKEv2 as Exchange, properly configure other options, apply configurations
   3) Create matching TI VPN policy on Remote_FW as following:
IPsec Primary Gateway Name or Address: Translated_FW_X1
   4) On Local FW, go to Network->Routing, add a static routing policy, select Local_FW_X0_subnet as Source, select Remote_FW_X0_Subnet as Destination, select TI policy 'test' as Interface, enable 'Auto-add Access Rules', apply configuration.
   5)On Remote FW, configure matching static routing.
   6)Enable Keep Alive or make vpn traffic to trigger tunnel negotiation
49.title: Function: Tunnel Interface - Initiator Behind NAT - Initiator: IKEv2 mode with pershared secret; Responder: IKEv2 mode with Preshared secret
49.result:
After Step5, you should be able to establish VPN tunnel, there should be corresponding log for tunnel negotiation.
   After Step6, vpn traffic from Local_FW_X0_subnet to Remote_FW_X0_Subnet should be succeed
